applicabilityBasis.summary: apyUSD is an ERC-4626 non-rebasing yield-vault share over apxUSD. Its exchange rate accrues yield and redemption returns a variable amount of apxUSD, rather than a fixed dollar or other monetary-value payment obligation. It is classified separately from the underlying token as a non-payment-token savings/strategy position; this is not an inherited GENIUS authorization or a finding that the underlying token is excluded.

references.label: Apyx apyUSD overview: ERC-4626 savings token

genius.notes: apyUSD is treated as a non-payment token on its own yield-accruing vault rights, not because of crypto/preferred-equity collateral or user geographic restrictions. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization or foreign exception is asserted. Parent apxUSD remains separately assessed as unclear/no-public-authorization-found. IssuerEntity and issuerDomicile omitted consistently with apxUSD: terms establish Preference Capital (BVI) Ltd. as operator but deny protocol-asset claims against a specific entity, while Preference Foundation is evidenced only as securities owner. Public documentation gives conflicting redemption cooldown descriptions; neither timing claim is needed for the variable-share classification.
